name: Web Screens: Grid
description: A template presenting website screenshots in an animated grid. Good for showing multiple web designs or product features side by side.

name: WhatsApp Messages
description: An animated messaging template where chat bubbles appear in a conversation sequence. Perfect for messaging app UI mockups and social storytelling.

name: Animated Square Images
description: A template where square images animate into view in a coordinated grid sequence. Great for photo galleries and product image showcases.

name: Blog Post
description: An animated blog post layout template where text and images reveal as if being scrolled through for the first time. Perfect for editorial content demos and publication showcases.

name: Gradient Website [Dribbble]
description: A gradient website animation template with flowing sections inspired by Dribbble-quality design. Good for web design portfolios and colorful UI presentations.

name: Happy Faces: Landing Page
description: An animated landing page template with illustrated faces that give the product an approachable personality. Good for playful SaaS brands and consumer apps.

name: Image Mask: Parallax Effect
description: An image template with a parallax mask effect that adds depth as the content moves. Good for editorial websites and video presentations.

name: Landing Page: Blocks
description: An animated landing page template where content blocks reveal in sequence. Great for SaaS demos and website design presentations where you want to walk a viewer through the product clearly.

name: Minimalist Website
description: A minimal animated website template with refined transitions and careful use of space. Good for portfolio sites and design-forward product presentations.

name: Mountains: Animated Website [Dribbble]
description: A Dribbble-inspired animated website template with a dramatic mountain landscape. Good for travel brand presentations and editorial web design showcases.

name: Website Promo
description: A website promo template with scroll reveals and layered screen motion. Works well for agency reels and client presentations where you want to bring a web design to life.
